authentication.description: Free self-serve WorldEye API key (starts with wek_). Create one at https://worldeye.app/settings/api-keys. The key is sent as a connection header, never as a tool argument.

description: Search WorldEye's rights-cleared public camera catalogue and the USGS earthquake feed. Read-only.
name: app.worldeye/worldeye

headers.description: WorldEye API key (starts with wek_) as a bearer token. Create a free key at https://worldeye.app/settings/api-keys
headers.name: Authorization

title: WorldEye

tools.description: Search WorldEye's redistribution-cleared live camera catalogue by free text (name, city, country, source), one country (full name or ISO alpha-2 code), and/or media kind. Returns camera metadata, snapshot URLs and watch links, paginated.
tools.name: search_cameras
tools.title: Search cameras

tools.description: One camera by id from the cleared catalogue: metadata, snapshot URL and the watch link that opens it on the WorldEye globe. An id outside the cleared catalogue answers 'not found'.
tools.name: get_camera
tools.title: Get one camera

tools.description: Cameras within a radius of a place: give either lat+lng or a place name to geocode. Nearest first, each with its distance in km.
tools.name: cameras_near
tools.title: Cameras near a point

tools.description: The USGS earthquake feed as served on WorldEye: magnitude 2.5+ events from the last 24 hours, with place, magnitude, depth and event time.
tools.name: latest_earthquakes
tools.title: Latest earthquakes

tools.description: The calling API key's plan tier, daily quota and today's usage.
tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: API usage
